national.line: In South Carolina, children's goodbye letters for a senior dog went viral and helped get him adopted.
A tiny black cat found stuck in a car engine brought unexpected joy to a Sandy Springs, Georgia, couple whose wedding anniversary falls on Halloween.
A Knicks fan's hilarious Halloween display featuring Taylor Swift and Timothee Chalamet has gone viral.
Taylor Swift snapped and clapped with her wedding ring on full display as she danced at Sunday's Chiefs game.
The 2026 Dog Photography Awards named 18 finalists, and the top trophy went to a photographer named Caldwell for championing bully breeds like pit bulls.
A comedian perfectly captured the mysterious joy of checking the pockets of an old winter coat for the first time.

local.line: Lebanon Schools' Hive Depot is providing essential resources and learning opportunities for Lebanon students.
Osage Beach has a new city administrator, Keith Klostermann, a 30-year educator who spent time with the Orchard Farm School District.
A neighboring church stepped in and built a ramp for a Lebanon woman living with a rare condition called Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome, to make her daily life easier.
A group called Shine Through Faith is bringing helping hands to Marshfield, from mowing yards to picking up groceries for elderly neighbors.
The City of Lebanon has gone back to the drawing board with another new city logo, paired with a new slogan: 'Build your journey here.'
Nearly 2,300 boaters turned out for a sunny Fall Harbor Hop at Lake of the Ozarks to celebrate the end of another season.
The Joel E. Barber C-5 School District is considering building a high school addition onto its existing building.
Sixty years ago this week, Mrs. Jimmie Hayes of Buffalo showed off an unusual two-headed lizard she found, according to the Buffalo Reflex's look back at Dallas County history.
Residents of Colonial Springs Healthcare Center in Buffalo competed at Bolivar's Golden Age Games on October 9th.
Fall is prime time for white bass at Lake of the Ozarks, as the fish push into the shallows chasing shad.

weird.line: On his very first time snagging, a man from Olathe, Kansas, reeled in a world-record 164-pound paddlefish at Lake of the Ozarks.
Biologists netted a 70-pound lake sturgeon below a Missouri River dam and found a tag the size of a grain of rice showing it had swum 681 miles upstream in nine years.
Florida police got a call about a 'pedestrian' blocking traffic, and it turned out to be an alligator.
A black bear was caught on camera boxing a punching bag on a Southern California patio like a seasoned pro.
An emu that ran away from its owner was caught on video giving sheriff's deputies the slip.
A cow that escaped from a California slaughterhouse truck got a new life at a sanctuary with help from Diane Warren.
A tiny dog played the drums in an 'Angine de Pawtrine' tribute costume at New York City's annual Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade.
A 61-year-old grandmother of 12 just broke her own world record by holding a plank for five hours.
A woman bought a bizarre set of porcelain objects at a thrift store, and nobody seems to know what they're for.
A 6-year-old in Nebraska discovered a rare 200-million-year-old fossil of a jellyfish-like sea creature.
Cartoonist Matthew Inman of The Oatmeal built 'Grimothy,' a giant evil version of Jimothy, Seattle's viral raccoon, in his brother's front yard for Halloween.
A cow in Hillsborough County, Florida, spent eight hours stuck in the mud of Boat Bayou before it was rescued.
There's a new heaviest pumpkin in the world, and the champion grower is American.
An Ohio mare set a world record for the longest horse tail.
Scientists identified a new dinosaur species from a fossil that sat stashed in a drawer for a century.
A 10,000-year-old fossilized mastodon was found in a creek.
Scientists found a bizarre insect from the age of the dinosaurs that had a mouth twice the length of its body.
A rare fossil of a T. rex cousin is on display in New York before it heads to auction.
A Colorado community is raising money for its firefighters with help from Goldie the goat.
Boeing has explained the mysterious object people spotted being hauled along North Lindbergh.
West Virginia turns out to hold plenty of strange and fun Guinness World Records.

music.line: Morgan Wallen's Sand In My Boots festival is reportedly set to return in 2027.
Tim McGraw fought back tears honoring his mom, Faith Hill and their daughters in his Hall of Fame speech, joking, 'There's a lot of estrogen in my house.'
Lainey Wilson performed in Tim McGraw's honor at his Country Music Hall of Fame ceremony and talked about a letter she wrote him when she was 18.
Megan Moroney became the first country singer to wear Victoria's Secret Angel wings.
Luke Bryan is sharing what he expects from American Idol's 25th season, a decade after he started judging the show.
One year after its release, Ella Langley says she is still constantly and consistently amazed by her hit 'Choosin' Texas.'
Zach Top has released two new tracks, 'Good Girls and Cowgirls' and 'Other Side of Hurtin'.'
Toby Keith's 'Red Solo Cup' turned a plastic cup into a party anthem, and the song's success created real problems for the company that makes them.
Morgan Wallen, Garth Brooks and Taylor Swift are among the artists with the most weeks at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Country Albums chart.
Trace Adkins is celebrating 30 years of his 'Dreamin' Out Loud' album with its first-ever vinyl release.
Morgan Wallen is curating his own 24-hour SiriusXM channel called Morgan Wallen Radio.
Zach Bryan credits Evan Felker and Jason Isbell with inspiring him to get sober.
Kip Moore brought out a local youth choir in South Africa for a moving performance of 'Faith in the Wind.'
The new Street Fighter movie gave the masked role of Vega to a country star who has never shown his face onstage.
Vince Gill and Marty Stuart teamed up on a new album, 'Marty and Me,' that Saving Country Music calls twangy and tasty.

humor.line: My wife is really mad that I have no sense of direction, so I packed up my stuff and right.
James Hetfield left Metallica to become a priest at the Jim Henson Company. He's now a Pastor of Muppets.
What do you call a criminal landing an airplane? Condescending.

pride.line: Congratulations to the Lebanon High School Marching Yellowjackets, who placed at the Valhalla Marching Festival.
Congratulations to Marshfield Chevrolet, which is celebrating 100 years of serving the community.
Congratulations to Lebanon Schools on the opening of the Robert W. Plaster Center for Student Success.
Congratulations to new Missouri State Highway Patrol troopers Ashton Wise, a 2022 Camdenton High School graduate, and Erin Bock, who are assigned to Camden and Miller counties.

pride.names: Camdenton Lakers football team, Michael Maschino

pride.line: Congratulations to Wood Elementary teacher Michael McGuire, this week's Teacher Proud shout-out from Waynesville schools.
Congratulations to Buffalo Alderman Eric Kirchberg, who earned the Certified Municipal Official designation from the Missouri Municipal League.
Congratulations to the Waynesville High School Class of 1966, which donated $775 to the district's Snack in a Pack program during its class reunion.
Congratulations to the kindergarten and fifth grade classes at Gasconade C-4 Schools for earning perfect attendance in the first quarter.

pride.line: Fordland Schools is thanking Mrs. Foraker and Mr. Cook, who lead its schools, for their dedication to Eagle Nation.
